methods_quotes.q: For BRFSS analyses, statistical software was used to account for the complex sampling design.
Differences in COPD prevalence among rural respondents compared with those of other urban-rural subgroups were determined by t-tests.
Urban-rural differences in Medicare hospitalizations and death rates were determined by the Z-test.
All two-sided tests were considered statistically significant at α = 0.05.
